scope: Owner-defined repository cleanup and engineering maintenance, clarified on November 25 and 26. These commitments govern development of the repository.

outcomes.intent: Audit and clean the whole repository as implemented, repair its accumulated technical debt and known problems, and actively look for previously unreported defects.
acceptance: Account for implemented components, consumer paths, affected platforms, dependencies and repository hygiene. Use adversarial inputs, recovery and ordinary interactions where suitable. Retain the exact scope and observed limits.

Register, diagnose, correct and verify confirmed in-scope problems. Retain the original failure, relevant independent review, current regression, protected integration and applicable native observations. Recheck the integrated revision.

outcomes.intent: Enable AI agents to sustain high-quality implementation, diagnosis, maintenance and evolution without the owner having to notice or restate the problem.
acceptance: Show a concise accurate whole-project view through the ordinary entry. Provide detailed authoritative records, accountable follow-through and original observations on demand. A fresh AI must recover the work across interruptions.

For each consequential incident, compare implementation, contract, validation and operating causes on evidence. Reproduce the fault at the consumer boundary, retain positive and negative controls, and verify recovery after integration.
Exercise unseen failures, conflicting or missing evidence, routine work, independent decisions and real due periodic reviews. Evaluate recurrence and the burden of maintaining the solution over time.

When requirements, recurrence, measured cost or supported workflows justify changing a design, evaluate repair, replacement or retirement, preserve callers and user data, verify transitions and remove obsolete paths. Reassess the improvement on a later comparable change.

observations: A new coordination session reconciled dispatches and described their restoration as this task’s completion condition. The owner then restated the two continuing outcomes. The original pause marker held a hashed operational handoff. The protected overview led to product focus M2-003.

The previous coordinator exercised an unseen synthetic market failure and core maintenance boundaries. This establishes coverage of those exercises. Timing provenance corrections and an actual due-cycle observation remain open.

limits: Platform and calendar observations retain their actual status. Existing project permissions, release acceptance and protected checks govern their own operations.
